title: Prepared Confirm bar above the question's dialog
description: A secondary prepared in Review mode: when the real question opens, the bar "Prepared ... Confirm / Choose myself" must stay clickable above the dialog. After the overlays container started rising to the dialog layer (dialog headers were clipped under the top bar), the floating prep panel (one layer above the old overlays layer) ended up under the dialog and Confirm could not be clicked: in the consolidated smoke run (seeds 7007/81) all three review confirms failed. The before shot is committed (taken without the CSS rule), the after shot is regenerated by npm run screenshots -- AR.

shots.heading: Before
shots.caption: The dialog lies over the bar: the element at the Confirm button's centre is the dialog, a click lands on the backdrop.

shots.heading: After
shots.caption: While a backdrop dialog is open the floating prep panel rises with the overlays container, so the bar stays above the dialog and Confirm is the topmost element at its centre.
